Name: I Need A Loan
Author: sakinolemir
Description:
[size=4]I Need A Loan! aims to speed up your progress in early-mid game. When sudden expenses hit, like birthdays or festivals, it gives you some economic alternatives to fall back on. It's a fully balanced system, doesn't make things easier than they should be, and can even get tougher than expected in some cases.[/size]

[size=4]Basically there are two groups you can borrow from: [/size]

[quote][size=4][b][color=#ff7700]Personal Loan:[/color][/b] Is a loan type you can get from regular [u]townsfolk[/u] like Abigail, Sebastian or Penny. It gives you low to moderate amounts but comes interest free. It's expected back on a short term, within 2 to 4 days. You can hold personal loans from up to 4 people at once. Maximum amount a villager can lend scales with your friendship level and your total earnings. Personal Loan works best for getting through a rough day or covering a small gap in your cash. Personal Loan needs [b][color=#e06666]1 heart friendship[/color][/b].

[b][url=https://ibb.co/67QMfBPn][img width=888]https://i.ibb.co/zTdM0JRn/birlesik-2.png[/img][/url][/b][/size][/quote]
[quote][url=https://ibb.co/vv6S4sPC][/url][size=4] [b][color=#ff7700]Business Loan:[/color][/b] Is a loan type you can get from shop owners like Pierre, Robin or Clint. It gives you higher returns but comes with daily interest. You decide your own term length and repayment plan. You can hold business loans from up to 2 people at once. Maximum amount a shopkeeper can lend depends on their own wealth and how many hearts you've built with them, same as personal loans. Business Loan is usually taken to fund your long term plans. Business Loan only needs [b][color=#e06666]half heart friendship[/color][/b].

[url=https://ibb.co/vv6S4sPC][img width=888]https://i.ibb.co/5xgPhY8X/birlesik.png[/img][/url][/size][/quote]
[size=4][b][color=#ff7700][i]Repayment Types (Business Loan)[/i][/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Daily Installment: Debt gets split evenly across your chosen number of days and cut automatically every day.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Weekly Installment: Debt gets cut as a single installment every Monday.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Free Payment: No automatic deduction, you can pay in parts or all at once whenever you want before term ends.[/size] [/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff7700][size=4][i]Finance[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]Villagers financial standing differs from one another, rated on a scale from 1 to 5. Higher tier means bigger loan available once your friendship level allows it. For shopkeepers, interest rate ties directly to how much credit they offer. Higher interest a shopkeeper charges, more credit they can lend.[/size]

[quote][size=4]Peoples financial standing stays fixed, nobody's wallet changes at random. This mod mainly targets early and mid game, built for those moments you need a few thousand gold but don't have it on hand. By late game you'll already be earning thousands of gold a day, so fixed limits can end up meaningless for you.
If you don't want that, you can turn on "Scale Loans With Income" in settings, and as your total earnings grow, everyone's max loan grows right along with it. Disabled by default since that's not what this mod's about, but we added it so anyone chasing late game relevance gets that option too.[/size][/quote]
[size=4][color=#ff7700][b][i]Penalty[/i][/b][/color][/size]
[size=4]If you don't pay off an overdue loan, your friendship points drop by -50 every day. Cash on hand gets collected automatically, and if you don't have enough or have none at all, remaining debt just carries over. No extra interest gets applied, but you can't take a new loan from any shop owner while you have an overdue debt.[/size]

[size=4][color=#ff7700][b][i]Debt Ledger[/i][/b][/color][/size]
[size=4]Opens with a key you can rebind in settings, default is F4. Shows every loan you've got open at once, who you owe, how much, payment method, and how many days are left before it's due. Quick way to check your whole financial situation without walking around town talking to everyone.[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=5]Multiplayer & Gamepad Support[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]Tested in 1.6.X[/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]Compatible with Vanilla[/size][/color]
